sections.title: Burns Night at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Robert Burns was born on 25 January 1759, and every year around that date Scotland sits down to supper in his memory. At Bentley Hotel the evening follows the old pattern. Guests gather for a drink, the haggis is carried to the top table, piped in when we can arrange a piper, and it is addressed with the knife raised at the right line. Then everyone eats.

The supper is a traditional one, cooked in our own kitchen, with the haggis at its heart. If haggis is not for you, tell us when you book and we’ll offer an alternative. Then come the toasts: the Immortal Memory, the toast to the lassies and the reply, with a few verses of Burns along the way. Ask what else is planned for this year’s night when you enquire.

It is a sociable evening. Tables of friends, families and colleagues sit alongside couples, in an air-conditioned function suite that seats up to 100. Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk, parking is free, and our 18 en-suite rooms are in the same building if you’d rather stay than drive home.

sections.title: The room, the supper and the night after

items.title: The function suite
items.text: Our Back o' Barns function suite seats up to 100 for dinner and is air-conditioned. Small parties can share a table or have their own.

items.title: The supper
items.text: A traditional Burns supper cooked in our own kitchen, with an alternative for anyone who'd rather not have haggis. The menu is confirmed each season.

items.title: Stay the night
items.text: With 18 en-suite rooms in the hotel, nobody needs to drive. Check-in is from 2pm, check-out by 11am, and a full Scottish breakfast is cooked to order when it is part of your rate.

sections.title: Burns Night: what people ask us

items.q: How do we book a table for Burns Night?
items.a: Call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry with your numbers. We’ll confirm this year’s date, menu and price and hold your table. Seats are limited, so the earlier the better.

items.q: Do we need to pay a deposit?
items.a: We may ask for a deposit to hold a group table. If so, we’ll tell you the amount, when it is due and our cancellation terms before you commit.

items.q: Can you cater for dietary requirements, and what if I don't like haggis?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan guests when you book, and we’ll arrange an alternative for anyone who’d rather not have haggis.

items.q: Is there parking, and can we come by train?
items.a: Parking at the hotel is free. Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk, and the fastest trains reach Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes. If you’d rather not travel late, book a room and stay the night.

sections.title: Join us for Burns Night
sections.text: Tell us how many are coming and we’ll hold your table. Rooms for the night can be booked online.
